user_query: I'm designing a greeting card for my best friend's birthday and I want to make it funny. Can you find me a chuck norris jokes API to include humorous messages? Additionally, suggest a love calculator API to add a touch of sentimentalism to the card.

TaskList.description: Find an API that provides Chuck Norris jokes to include humorous messages in the greeting card.
Find an API that acts as a love calculator to add sentimental messages to the greeting card.
Combine the jokes from the Chuck Norris jokes API and the results from the love calculator API to create a humorous and sentimental greeting card design.
